NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: To suggest your latest video in Spotter, as you asked, or to let you choose a photo of yourself for the virtual try-on. {nom} only reads the most recent video or the photo you choose, and never changes your photos or videos; only a few frames of the video leave your iPhone, when you tap “Search”, and the photo, when you tap “Start the try-on”.
NSCameraUsageDescription: To take a photo of a piece you want to find in Spotter, your profile photo, or a photo of yourself for the virtual try-on. The photo isn't saved to your gallery; it only leaves your iPhone when you tap “Search”, “Confirm” or “Start the try-on”.
NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: To save the image of your virtual try-on to your photos, when you tap “Save image”. {nom} only adds that image, without reading or changing your other photos.
